analysis: The PR changes only docs/provider/cli-reference.md: it bumps the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and adds a head-side paragraph (head lines ~1577-1588) describing time comparisons that use timeIntervalSince(_:) instead of Date >=/<=, plus build-time guards (scripts/check-date-comparisons.py, scripts/check-provider-weak-imports.py). The supplied base text covers lines 1-792 only; the changed hunk sits beyond that, so it was reviewed from the patch excerpt, which is complete. The change is documentation-only. It alters no code, no control, and none of the trust boundaries or assets in the threat model (TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-011, TB-012, TB-013; A-001 through A-019). The text describes an availability fix, a crash loop caused by a weak-import symbol missing on pre-release macOS 27.2. It also describes build-time checks that refuse binaries importing those symbols. Those checks are availability and release-integrity hygiene; they do not weaken authentication, attestation, encryption, or the prefix cache (T-041). I could not verify that the referenced scripts or the build.md anchor exist or behave as claimed. The statement that limits and results stay the same is a documentation claim that code review must confirm. The base content in this batch (cache, switch, drain, cluster docs) is unchanged, so I raise no pre-existing issues. No new attack surface and no threat-model update are needed.
